access_id.Description: The access ID of the HMAC Key.

service_account_email.Description: The email address of the key's associated service account.

state.Description: The state of the key. Can be set to one of ACTIVE, INACTIVE. Default value: "ACTIVE" Possible values: ["ACTIVE", "INACTIVE"]

time_created.Description: 'The creation time of the HMAC key in RFC 3339 format. '

updated.Description: 'The last modification time of the HMAC key metadata in RFC 3339 format.'
